name: Step jacks
instructions: Stand tall with feet together.
Step one foot out while lifting both arms, then return.
Alternate sides without jumping and keep knees soft.
cue: Step one foot out while lifting both arms, then return.

name: Squat to reach
instructions: Place feet hip-width apart.
Sit back into a comfortable squat, then stand and reach up.
Keep heels grounded and avoid locking the knees.
cue: Sit back into a comfortable squat, then stand and reach up.

name: Mountain climbers
instructions: Place hands below shoulders in a high plank.
Bring one knee toward the chest, then switch legs.
Keep hips steady and slow down if your back arches.
cue: Bring one knee toward the chest, then switch legs.

name: Half burpees
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and clear the floor area.
Squat, place hands down, step back to plank and step forward to stand.
Use controlled steps rather than jumps and stop for wrist discomfort.
cue: Squat, place hands down, step back to plank and step forward to stand.

name: Fast feet
instructions: Stand in a shallow athletic stance.
Take rapid small steps in place.
Stay relaxed through the shoulders and land softly.
cue: Take rapid small steps in place.

name: Skater steps
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Step diagonally to one side and tap the trailing foot behind.
Alternate sides with a small knee bend, keeping balance.
cue: Step diagonally to one side and tap the trailing foot behind.

name: Squat pulses
instructions: Stand wider than hip-width with toes slightly out.
Lower into a comfortable squat and make small controlled pulses.
Keep knees aligned with toes and stand to rest when needed.
cue: Lower into a comfortable squat and make small controlled pulses.

name: Standing knee drive
instructions: Stand tall with hands in front of your chest.
Lift one knee toward your hands, lower, then alternate.
Keep the motion controlled and avoid pulling your head down.
cue: Lift one knee toward your hands, lower, then alternate.

name: Bodyweight squat
instructions: Set feet about shoulder-width apart.
Send hips back and bend knees only as far as comfortable.
Push through your whole foot to stand, keeping knees aligned.
cue: Send hips back and bend knees only as far as comfortable.

name: Wall push-up
instructions: Face a solid wall and place hands at shoulder height.
Step feet back, bend elbows to bring your chest toward the wall, then press away.
Keep your body straight and use a shallower lean to make it easier.
cue: Step feet back, bend elbows to bring your chest toward the wall, then press away.

name: Knee push-up
instructions: Kneel on a comfortable surface with hands under shoulders.
Keep a straight line from knees to head and lower your chest by bending elbows.
Press back up without letting your hips sag.
cue: Keep a straight line from knees to head and lower your chest by bending elbows.

name: Push-up
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Bend elbows back to lower your chest, then press away.
Brace gently and switch to a wall push-up if form changes.
cue: Bend elbows back to lower your chest, then press away.

name: Reverse lunge
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and bend both knees a comfortable amount.
Press through the front foot to return, alternating sides.
cue: Step one foot back and bend both knees a comfortable amount.

name: Glute bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with bent knees and feet flat on a comfortable surface.
Squeeze glutes and lift hips until thighs line up with your torso.
Lower slowly without over-arching your lower back.
cue: Squeeze glutes and lift hips until thighs line up with your torso.

name: Calf raise
instructions: Stand tall near a wall for optional balance support.
Lift both heels slowly, keeping weight over the balls of your feet.
Lower heels gently and avoid bouncing.
cue: Lift both heels slowly, keeping weight over the balls of your feet.

name: Wall sit
instructions: Rest your back against a solid wall with feet a little forward.
Slide down only to a comfortable knee angle and hold.
Keep breathing and slide up if knees hurt.
cue: Slide down only to a comfortable knee angle and hold.

name: Standing hip abduction
instructions: Stand tall near a wall for optional balance support.
Lift one leg a little to the side with toes facing forward.
Lower slowly and switch sides halfway without leaning.
cue: Lift one leg a little to the side with toes facing forward.

name: Standing glute squeeze
instructions: Stand comfortably with knees soft.
Gently squeeze your glutes for two seconds.
Release fully and repeat while breathing normally.
cue: Gently squeeze your glutes for two seconds.

name: Jumping jacks
instructions: Start with feet together and arms by your sides.
Jump feet apart while sweeping arms overhead, then return.
Land softly with knees relaxed, or choose step jacks.
cue: Jump feet apart while sweeping arms overhead, then return.

name: High knees
instructions: Stand tall and clear the space around you.
Jog in place while lifting knees to a comfortable height.
Land softly and keep your torso upright.
cue: Jog in place while lifting knees to a comfortable height.

name: Invisible-rope skipping
instructions: Stand with elbows close to your sides as if holding a rope.
Make small soft hops while circling your wrists.
Use tiny hops and choose heel digs if impact is uncomfortable.
cue: Make small soft hops while circling your wrists.

name: Stair climbing
instructions: Choose a dry, well-lit staircase with a handrail and no traffic.
Walk up at a steady pace, using the rail as needed.
Walk down slowly, watch each step, and never race or skip stairs.
cue: Walk up at a steady pace, using the rail as needed.

name: Easy march
instructions: Stand tall with enough room to move your arms.
Lift and lower alternate feet gently in place.
Keep steps small, breathe normally, and avoid stomping.
cue: Lift and lower alternate feet gently in place.

name: Heel digs
instructions: Stand with soft knees and hands relaxed.
Tap one heel forward, return, and alternate feet.
Keep your weight over the supporting foot and use small steps.
cue: Tap one heel forward, return, and alternate feet.

name: Side step touch
instructions: Stand with feet comfortably apart.
Step right and tap the left foot beside it, then repeat left.
Keep the movement small and land quietly.
cue: Step right and tap the left foot beside it, then repeat left.

name: Butt kicks
instructions: Stand upright with a clear floor area.
Jog gently while lifting heels toward your glutes.
Keep knees pointing down and do not force the heel height.
cue: Jog gently while lifting heels toward your glutes.

name: Shadow boxing
instructions: Stand with staggered feet and soft knees.
Alternate controlled forward punches at chest height.
Keep elbows soft and turn gently through the torso without snapping joints.
cue: Alternate controlled forward punches at chest height.

name: Low-impact knee lifts
instructions: Stand tall with hands resting at your sides.
Lift one knee to a comfortable height, then lower and alternate.
Keep your supporting knee soft and avoid leaning back.
cue: Lift one knee to a comfortable height, then lower and alternate.

name: Standing breathing
instructions: Stand comfortably or sit if you prefer.
Let your shoulders soften and take slow, comfortable breaths.
Do not hold your breath, and return to normal breathing if light-headed.
cue: Let your shoulders soften and take slow, comfortable breaths.

name: Standing side reach
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees relaxed.
Reach one arm overhead and lean gently to the opposite side.
Return to center, change sides halfway, and avoid twisting or painful range.
cue: Reach one arm overhead and lean gently to the opposite side.

name: Cat cow
instructions: Start on hands and knees on a comfortable, non-slip surface.
Round your back gently, then return through neutral to a small chest opening.
Move with easy breaths and avoid forcing your neck.
cue: Round your back gently, then return through neutral to a small chest opening.

name: Child pose
instructions: Kneel on a comfortable surface with knees as wide as feels good.
Sit hips gently toward heels and reach hands forward.
Keep the position pain-free and use a standing alternative if knees dislike kneeling.
cue: Sit hips gently toward heels and reach hands forward.

name: Downward dog
instructions: Begin on hands and knees with fingers spread.
Lift hips upward and back, keeping knees bent if needed.
Press through hands without forcing heels down or rounding into pain.
cue: Lift hips upward and back, keeping knees bent if needed.

name: Low cobra
instructions: Lie face down with palms beside your lower ribs on a comfortable surface.
Gently lift your chest a small amount using your back, with light hand support.
Keep elbows bent, pelvis grounded, and stop for back discomfort.
cue: Gently lift your chest a small amount using your back, with light hand support.

name: Standing forward fold
instructions: Stand with knees bent slightly and feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at your hips and lower your torso only as far as comfortable.
Let arms hang and rise slowly, skipping this move if it causes dizziness.
cue: Hinge at your hips and lower your torso only as far as comfortable.

name: Warrior two
instructions: Take a wide stance and turn one foot outward.
Bend the front knee gently and extend arms to the sides.
Keep knee aligned with toes, breathe, and switch sides halfway.
cue: Bend the front knee gently and extend arms to the sides.

name: Tree balance
instructions: Stand near a wall and shift weight to one foot.
Place the other foot against your ankle or calf, avoiding the knee joint.
Keep a hand on the wall if needed and change sides halfway.
cue: Place the other foot against your ankle or calf, avoiding the knee joint.

name: Shoulder rolls
instructions: Stand or sit tall with arms relaxed.
Lift shoulders slightly and circle them backward slowly.
Use small pain-free circles and relax between repetitions.
cue: Lift shoulders slightly and circle them backward slowly.

name: Ankle circles
instructions: Stand near a wall for balance or sit comfortably.
Lift one foot a little and make small circles at the ankle.
Reverse direction, then change feet halfway without straining.
cue: Lift one foot a little and make small circles at the ankle.

name: Standing chest opener
instructions: Stand tall with arms resting beside you.
Draw elbows back gently and lift the breastbone a little.
Keep ribs relaxed and avoid arching the lower back.
cue: Draw elbows back gently and lift the breastbone a little.

name: Forearm plank
instructions: Rest on forearms and toes with elbows beneath shoulders.
Make a straight line from head to heels and hold while breathing.
Lower knees or stop before your lower back begins to sag.
cue: Make a straight line from head to heels and hold while breathing.

name: High plank
instructions: Place hands under shoulders and extend legs behind you.
Brace your trunk gently and hold a straight body line.
Keep breathing and avoid locking elbows or lifting the chin.
cue: Brace your trunk gently and hold a straight body line.

name: Dead bug
instructions: Lie on your back with arms upward and hips and knees bent.
Slowly extend the opposite arm and leg without arching your back.
Return to start and alternate, using a smaller range if needed.
cue: Slowly extend the opposite arm and leg without arching your back.

name: Bird dog
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a neutral back.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg backward.
Return slowly and alternate while keeping hips level.
cue: Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg backward.

name: Gentle crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Exhale and lift your head and shoulders a small amount.
Lower slowly, keeping your neck relaxed rather than pulling it.
cue: Exhale and lift your head and shoulders a small amount.

name: Bent-knee leg raise
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands beside you.
Lift bent knees toward your chest a comfortable amount.
Lower slowly without arching your back, and stop for discomfort.
cue: Lift bent knees toward your chest a comfortable amount.

name: Side plank from knees
instructions: Lie on one side with knees bent and elbow below shoulder.
Lift your hips to make a line from knees to head.
Keep breathing, lower gently, and switch sides halfway.
cue: Lift your hips to make a line from knees to head.

name: Heel slides
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Slide one heel away slowly while keeping the pelvis still.
Return and change legs, shortening the slide if your back arches.
cue: Slide one heel away slowly while keeping the pelvis still.

name: Wall plank
instructions: Face a solid wall and place forearms at shoulder height.
Step back a little and hold a straight line from head to heels.
Keep breathing and reduce the lean if your shoulders feel strained.
cue: Step back a little and hold a straight line from head to heels.

name: Standing cross crunch
instructions: Stand with hands loosely near your chest.
Lift one knee and turn gently toward it with the opposite shoulder.
Alternate slowly without pulling your neck or forcing the twist.
cue: Lift one knee and turn gently toward it with the opposite shoulder.

name: Dance step touch
instructions: Stand with feet apart and shoulders relaxed.
Step to the side and tap the other foot in, adding a gentle arm swing.
Alternate to a comfortable rhythm and keep steps soft.
cue: Step to the side and tap the other foot in, adding a gentle arm swing.

name: Grapevine steps
instructions: Clear a few steps of floor space to each side.
Step sideways, cross the trailing foot behind, step sideways again and tap.
Repeat the other way slowly, replacing the cross with a tap if balance is difficult.
cue: Step sideways, cross the trailing foot behind, step sideways again and tap.

name: Dance knee lift
instructions: Stand tall with a clear space around you.
Take two easy steps in place, then lift one knee.
Alternate knees and add small arm movements at your own pace.
cue: Take two easy steps in place, then lift one knee.

name: Salsa basic
instructions: Stand with knees relaxed and feet under hips.
Step forward, shift weight back, and return to center.
Step backward on the other foot and repeat with small controlled steps.
cue: Step forward, shift weight back, and return to center.

name: Box step
instructions: Imagine a small square on the floor.
Step forward, sideways, together, then backward, sideways and together.
Go slowly and keep each step within your available space.
cue: Step forward, sideways, together, then backward, sideways and together.

name: Disco reaches
instructions: Stand with feet apart and soft knees.
Reach one hand diagonally overhead, lower it, then change sides.
Keep hips relaxed and use a comfortable shoulder range.
cue: Reach one hand diagonally overhead, lower it, then change sides.

name: Dance heel taps
instructions: Stand tall with feet under your hips.
Tap alternate heels forward to an easy rhythm.
Add a gentle arm sway without leaning back.
cue: Tap alternate heels forward to an easy rhythm.

name: Quiet dance sway
instructions: Stand with feet a comfortable distance apart.
Shift weight gently side to side without lifting your feet high.
Add a relaxed shoulder sway and keep breathing.
cue: Shift weight gently side to side without lifting your feet high.

name: Campus walk
instructions: Choose a safe, well-lit path with room for pedestrians.
Walk at a comfortable pace with relaxed arms.
Watch crossings and surfaces, and pause before interacting with your phone.
cue: Walk at a comfortable pace with relaxed arms.

name: Brisk campus walk
instructions: Choose a clear, safe campus route.
Walk briskly at a pace that still lets you speak in sentences.
Keep a natural stride and slow down for traffic, heat, or discomfort.
cue: Walk briskly at a pace that still lets you speak in sentences.

name: Easy jog
instructions: Use a safe route and warm up with easy walking.
Jog with short relaxed strides at a conversational pace.
Slow to a walk whenever needed and stay aware of your surroundings.
cue: Jog with short relaxed strides at a conversational pace.

name: Walk jog intervals
instructions: Choose a safe, level route and start with easy walking.
Alternate short easy jogs with longer walking recoveries.
Use your breathing as a guide and walk if you cannot speak comfortably.
cue: Alternate short easy jogs with longer walking recoveries.

name: Shallow squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Send hips back and bend knees just a little.
Stand slowly with heels grounded and stop if knees hurt.
cue: Send hips back and bend knees just a little.

name: Quiet standing reach
instructions: Stand with soft knees and arms by your sides.
Lift both arms only as high as feels comfortable, then lower.
Keep ribs relaxed and choose shoulder rolls for limited shoulder mobility.
cue: Lift both arms only as high as feels comfortable, then lower.

name: Quiet side bends
instructions: Stand tall with hands sliding down your sides.
Lean a small amount to one side, return, then change sides.
Keep both feet grounded and avoid twisting.
cue: Lean a small amount to one side, return, then change sides.

name: Silent heel raise
instructions: Stand near a wall with feet comfortably apart.
Lift heels slowly without hopping.
Lower heels with control so they touch down quietly.
cue: Lift heels slowly without hopping.

name: Quiet wall press
instructions: Face a solid wall with hands at shoulder height.
Lean into a small elbow bend and press away slowly.
Keep feet still and reduce the lean if needed.
cue: Lean into a small elbow bend and press away slowly.

name: Slow standing march
instructions: Stand upright with room for a small arm swing.
Lift each foot a little and place it down softly.
Keep a slow comfortable rhythm with no stomping.
cue: Lift each foot a little and place it down softly.

name: Gentle hip hinge
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees soft.
Push your hips back slightly while keeping your spine long.
Return by gently squeezing your glutes without leaning backward.
cue: Push your hips back slightly while keeping your spine long.

name: Quiet balance shift
instructions: Stand near a wall for optional support.
Shift weight gently from one foot to the other.
Keep both feet on the floor and the movement small.
cue: Shift weight gently from one foot to the other.

name: Quiet chest opening
instructions: Stand tall with elbows loosely bent beside you.
Draw elbows back a little while keeping shoulders down.
Relax and repeat, avoiding any painful stretch.
cue: Draw elbows back a little while keeping shoulders down.

name: Gentle torso turn
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands by your chest.
Turn your upper body a small amount to one side, then the other.
Keep hips mostly forward and never force the rotation.
cue: Turn your upper body a small amount to one side, then the other.
